summary_zh: 魅力 +1（最高 20）。假扮他人時，魅力（欺瞞、表演）檢定具有優勢。聽過某人說話或生物發聲至少 1 分鐘後，可模仿該聲音；聽者以感知（察言觀色）對抗你的魅力（欺瞞）檢定來識破。
summary_en: Charisma +1 (maximum 20). Gain advantage on Deception and Performance checks to impersonate someone. After hearing a person or creature for at least 1 minute, mimic its voice; listeners can detect the imitation with Insight contested by your Deception.

summary_zh: 先攻 +5。保持清醒時不會陷入突襲；其他生物不會僅因你看不見它，就對你的攻擊檢定獲得優勢。
summary_en: Initiative +5. While conscious, you cannot be surprised. Other creatures gain no advantage on attacks against you solely because you cannot see them.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20）。倒地後起身只需 5 呎移動力；攀爬不需額外移動力。助跑跳高或跳遠前，只需先移動 5 呎，而非 10 呎。
summary_en: Strength or Dexterity +1 (maximum 20). Standing from prone costs only 5 feet of movement. Climbing costs no extra movement. Running long and high jumps need only a 5-foot run-up instead of 10 feet.

summary_zh: 使用動作疾走時，可用附贈動作進行一次近戰武器攻擊或推撞。若在該附贈動作前立刻直線移動至少 10 呎，命中時傷害 +5，或推撞成功時將目標推離至多 10 呎。
summary_en: When you use your action to Dash, you may make one melee weapon attack or shove as a bonus action. If you move at least 10 feet straight immediately before that bonus action, gain +5 damage on a hit or push the target up to 10 feet on a successful shove.

summary_zh: 忽略你熟練使用之弩的裝填屬性；彈藥屬性仍適用，裝填單手武器仍需一隻空手。5 呎內有敵對生物不會使你的遠程攻擊具有劣勢。使用攻擊動作，以單手武器攻擊後，可用附贈動作以你持有的手弩攻擊一次。
summary_en: Ignore the loading property of crossbows you are proficient with; ammunition still applies, including a free hand to load a one-handed weapon. Hostile creatures within 5 feet do not impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks. After attacking with a one-handed weapon using the Attack action, make one bonus-action attack with a hand crossbow you hold.

summary_zh: 持用你熟練的靈巧武器，且被近戰攻擊命中時，可用反應將熟練加值加到 AC，僅對該次攻擊有效，可能使它改為未命中。
summary_en: When a melee attack hits you while you wield a finesse weapon you are proficient with, use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

summary_zh: 雙手各持一把近戰武器時 AC +1。進行雙武器戰鬥時，可使用非輕型的單手近戰武器；原本只能拔出或收起一把單手武器時，可改為同時處理兩把。
summary_en: Gain +1 AC while holding a separate melee weapon in each hand. Two-weapon fighting can use non-light one-handed melee weapons. Whenever you could draw or stow one one-handed weapon, you can draw or stow two instead.

summary_zh: 尋找祕門的感知（觀察）與智力（調查）檢定具有優勢。避免或抵抗陷阱的豁免具有優勢，且對陷阱造成的傷害具有抗性。快速旅行時，仍可正常尋找陷阱，不承受通常的被動感知（觀察）−5 減值。
summary_en: Gain advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to locate secret doors and on saves to avoid or resist traps. Gain resistance to trap damage. At a fast travel pace, search for traps normally without the usual −5 penalty to passive Perception.

summary_zh: 體魄 +1（最高 20）。擲生命骰恢復生命值時，每顆生命骰的最低恢復量為體魄調整值的兩倍，且至少恢復 2 點生命值。
summary_en: Constitution +1 (maximum 20). When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum regained per die is twice your Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 2 hit points.

prerequisite_en: Ability to cast at least one spell
summary_zh: 選擇強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電或雷鳴。你施放的法術忽略對該類型傷害的抗性；擲該類型的法術傷害骰時，可將骰值 1 視為 2。可重複選取此專長，但每次須選不同類型。
summary_en: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore resistance to that damage type, and you may treat a 1 on a spell damage die of that type as a 2. You may take this feat again, choosing a different type each time.

summary_zh: 對被你擒抱的生物進行攻擊時具有優勢。可用一個動作，對你擒抱中的生物再作一次擒抱檢定；成功時，你與目標都陷入束縛，直到擒抱結束。
summary_en: Gain advantage on attacks against a creature you grapple. As an action, make another grapple check against it; on success, both you and it are restrained until the grapple ends.

summary_zh: 在你的回合，以近戰武器造成重擊，或使生物生命值降至 0 時，可用附贈動作進行一次近戰武器攻擊。以你熟練的重型武器進行近戰攻擊前，可選擇攻擊檢定 −5，命中時傷害 +10。
summary_en: On your turn, a critical hit with a melee weapon or reducing a creature to 0 hit points with one lets you make a bonus-action melee weapon attack. Before a melee attack with a heavy weapon you are proficient with, you may take −5 to the attack roll for +10 damage on a hit.

summary_zh: 力量 +1（最高 20），並獲得重甲熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with heavy armor.

summary_zh: 力量 +1（最高 20）。穿著重甲時，受到非魔法武器造成的鈍擊、穿刺或揮砍傷害，每次減少 3 點。
summary_en: Strength +1 (maximum 20). While wearing heavy armor, reduce bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons by 3.

summary_zh: 花費 10 分鐘激勵同伴。選擇 30 呎內至多六個能看見或聽見你、且理解你的友善生物（可包括你）；各獲得等於你角色等級 + 魅力調整值的暫時生命值。生物接受此效果後，須完成短休或長休才能再次受益。
summary_en: Spend 10 minutes inspiring up to six friendly creatures within 30 feet, including yourself, that can see or hear and understand you. Each gains temporary hit points equal to your character level + Charisma modifier. A creature must finish a short or long rest before benefiting again.

summary_zh: 智力 +1（最高 20）。你總能辨別北方，知道距離下次日出或日落還有幾小時，並能準確回憶過去一個月內所見所聞。
summary_en: Intelligence +1 (maximum 20). You always know north, the hours until the next sunrise or sunset, and can accurately recall what you have seen or heard in the past month.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得輕甲熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with light armor.

summary_zh: 智力 +1（最高 20），學會三種自選語言。你可以編寫密碼；除非你教導、對方通過 DC 等於你智力值 + 熟練加值的智力檢定，或使用魔法，否則無法破解。
summary_en: Intelligence +1 (maximum 20) and learn three languages of your choice. Create written ciphers that others need your teaching, an Intelligence check against DC equal to your Intelligence score + proficiency bonus, or magic to decipher.

summary_zh: 你有 3 點幸運點，長休後全部恢復。進行攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免時，可在擲骰後、結果判定前花費 1 點，額外擲 d20 並選擇使用的骰值；也可在有人對你攻擊時，以同樣方式在該攻擊骰與你的額外 d20 中選擇。若多個生物以幸運點影響同一次擲骰，彼此抵銷，不額外擲骰。
summary_en: You have 3 luck points, restored on a long rest. After rolling an attack, check, or save but before its outcome is determined, spend 1 point for an extra d20 and choose the die used. You may also spend a point when attacked, choosing between the attacker’s die and your extra d20. If multiple creatures spend luck points on the same roll, the points cancel and no extra dice are rolled.

summary_zh: 5 呎內生物施法時，可用反應對它進行一次近戰武器攻擊。被你造成傷害的生物，為維持專注所作的豁免具有劣勢。你對抗 5 呎內生物施放的法術時，豁免具有優勢。
summary_en: When a creature within 5 feet casts a spell, use your reaction for a melee weapon attack against it. Creatures you damage have disadvantage on saves to maintain concentration. Gain advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet.

summary_zh: 選擇吟遊詩人、牧師、德魯伊、術士、契術師或法師，從該職業學會兩個戲法及一個 1 環法術。該 1 環法術可不消耗法術位，以最低環級施放一次，長休後恢復；施法屬性依所選職業而定。
summary_en: Choose bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from that class. Cast the 1st-level spell once at its lowest level without a slot, regaining this use after a long rest. Use the chosen class’s spellcasting ability.

summary_zh: 學會兩個戰鬥大師戰技，並獲得一顆 d6 卓越骰；短休或長休後恢復。戰技豁免 DC = 8 + 熟練加值 + 力量或敏捷調整值（由你選擇）。
summary_en: Learn two Battle Master maneuvers and gain one d6 superiority die, restored on a short or long rest. Maneuver save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier.

summary_zh: 穿著中甲時，敏捷（隱藏）檢定不再因護甲而具有劣勢。若敏捷為 16 以上，計算中甲 AC 時，可加入至多 +3 的敏捷調整值，而非 +2。
summary_en: Medium armor no longer imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. With Dexterity 16 or higher, add up to +3 of your Dexterity modifier to medium armor AC instead of +2.

summary_zh: 速度增加 10 呎。使用疾走動作時，困難地形在該回合不消耗額外移動力。對生物進行近戰攻擊後，無論命中與否，該生物在本回合都不會因你移開而獲得對你的機會攻擊。
summary_en: Your speed increases by 10 feet. After using Dash, difficult terrain costs no extra movement that turn. After making a melee attack against a creature, hit or miss, you do not provoke opportunity attacks from it for the rest of that turn.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得中甲與盾牌熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

summary_zh: 騎乘且未失能時，對體型小於坐騎、且未騎乘的生物，近戰攻擊具有優勢。可使原本以坐騎為目標的攻擊改為以你為目標。坐騎對通常允許敏捷豁免成功減半傷害的效果，成功時不受傷害，失敗時只受一半傷害。
summary_en: While mounted and not incapacitated, gain advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount. You may redirect attacks targeting your mount to yourself. Against effects allowing a Dexterity save for half damage, your mount takes none on success and half on failure.

summary_zh: 智力或感知 +1（最高 20）。能看見說話者的嘴、且理解其語言時，可讀懂唇語。被動感知（觀察）與被動智力（調查）各 +5。
summary_en: Intelligence or Wisdom +1 (maximum 20). Read lips if you can see the speaker’s mouth and understand the language. Gain +5 to passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation).

summary_zh: 使用攻擊動作，且只以長柄刀、戟、長棍或短矛攻擊時，可用附贈動作以武器另一端進行一次近戰攻擊，造成 1d4 鈍擊傷害，並使用主要攻擊相同的屬性調整值。持用這些武器或長槍時，生物進入你的觸及範圍也會引發你的機會攻擊。
summary_en: After taking the Attack action and attacking only with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, make one bonus-action melee attack with its opposite end for 1d4 bludgeoning damage, using the same ability modifier. While wielding these weapons or a pike, creatures also provoke opportunity attacks when entering your reach.

summary_zh: 一項屬性 +1（最高 20），並獲得該屬性的豁免熟練。
summary_en: Increase one ability score by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

summary_zh: 選擇吟遊詩人、牧師、德魯伊、術士、契術師或法師，獲得儀式書，內含該職業法術表中兩個自選的 1 環儀式法術。持有儀式書時，可依儀式施放；施法能力依所選職業決定。找到所選職業的書面儀式法術時，若環級不超過角色等級的一半（無條件進位），可抄入書中；每環須花費 2 小時與 50 gp。
summary_en: Choose bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. Gain a ritual book containing two 1st-level ritual spells of your choice from that class list. With the book in hand, you can cast them as rituals using that class’s spellcasting ability. Written ritual spells from that class can be copied if their level is no higher than half your character level, rounded up. Copying costs 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level.

summary_zh: 每回合一次，擲近戰武器攻擊的傷害時，可重擲該武器的傷害骰，並選擇使用原本或重擲後的總值。
summary_en: Once per turn when rolling damage for a melee weapon attack, reroll the weapon’s damage dice and use either the original or rerolled total.

summary_zh: 機會攻擊命中後，目標在該回合的速度變為 0。5 呎內的生物即使撤離，離開你的觸及範圍仍會引發機會攻擊。5 呎內生物攻擊你以外的目標，而該目標沒有此專長時，可用反應對攻擊者進行一次近戰武器攻擊。
summary_en: Your opportunity-attack hits reduce the target’s speed to 0 for that turn. Creatures within 5 feet still provoke opportunity attacks when leaving your reach despite Disengage. When a creature within 5 feet attacks someone other than you who lacks this feat, use your reaction for a melee weapon attack against the attacker.

summary_zh: 遠程武器攻擊不因超過一般射程而具有劣勢，並忽略半掩護與四分之三掩護。以你熟練的遠程武器攻擊前，可選擇攻擊檢定 −5，命中時傷害 +10。
summary_en: Ranged weapon attacks do not suffer long-range disadvantage and ignore half and three-quarters cover. Before an attack with a ranged weapon you are proficient with, you may take −5 to the attack roll for +10 damage on a hit.

summary_zh: 持盾且在自己的回合使用攻擊動作時，可用附贈動作以盾推撞 5 呎內生物。未失能時，對抗只以你為目標之法術或有害效果的敏捷豁免，可加上盾牌的 AC 加值。若某效果通常允許敏捷豁免成功減半傷害，可在豁免成功時用反應，改為完全不受傷害。
summary_en: While wielding a shield, taking the Attack action on your turn permits a bonus-action shield shove against a creature within 5 feet. While not incapacitated, add the shield’s AC bonus to Dexterity saves against spells or harmful effects targeting only you. Against an effect allowing a Dexterity save for half damage, use your reaction on a successful save to take no damage.

summary_zh: 獲得任選三項技能或工具熟練。
summary_en: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.
pro_skill_zh: 任選三項技能或工具（合計三項）
pro_skill_en: Any combination of three skills or tools (three total)
pro_tool_zh: 任選三項技能或工具（合計三項）
pro_tool_en: Any combination of three skills or tools (three total)

summary_zh: 可在相對於你要躲避的生物而言，僅有輕度遮蔽時嘗試躲藏。躲藏中以遠程武器攻擊未命中，不會因此暴露位置。昏暗光照不會使依賴視覺的感知（觀察）檢定具有劣勢。
summary_en: You can try to hide when only lightly obscured from the creature you are hiding from. Missing a ranged weapon attack while hidden does not reveal your position. Dim light does not impose disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.

prerequisite_en: Ability to cast at least one spell
summary_zh: 施放需要攻擊檢定的法術時，施法距離加倍；你的遠程法術攻擊忽略半掩護與四分之三掩護。從吟遊詩人、牧師、德魯伊、術士、契術師或法師法術表學會一個需要攻擊檢定的戲法，並使用所選職業的施法屬性。
summary_en: Double the range of spells requiring an attack roll. Your ranged spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Learn one attack-roll cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard list, using that class’s spellcasting ability.

summary_zh: 力量或體魄 +1（最高 20），獲得臨時武器熟練；徒手打擊的傷害骰變為 d4。在自己的回合以徒手打擊或臨時武器命中生物後，可用附贈動作嘗試擒抱該目標。
summary_en: Strength or Constitution +1 (maximum 20). Gain proficiency with improvised weapons and use d4 for unarmed-strike damage. After hitting a creature with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon on your turn, use a bonus action to try to grapple it.

summary_zh: 生命值上限增加等於目前角色等級 × 2 的數值。此後每獲得一個角色等級，生命值上限再額外增加 2。
summary_en: Your hit point maximum increases by twice your current character level, and increases by an additional 2 whenever you gain a character level thereafter.

prerequisite_en: Ability to cast at least one spell
summary_zh: 因受到傷害而為維持專注進行的體魄豁免具有優勢。雙手持有武器或盾牌時，仍可執行法術的姿勢成分。敵對生物的移動引發你的機會攻擊時，可用反應改為對它施放一個施法時間為 1 個動作、且只以它為目標的法術。
summary_en: Gain advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration due to damage. Perform somatic components with weapons or a shield in your hands. When hostile movement provokes your opportunity attack, use your reaction to cast a spell instead; it must have a casting time of 1 action and target only that creature.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得任選四種簡易或軍用武器熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice.
